title: Кристалл, Ярославль
purpose: Cartoon style revision of the five shopping mall landmark variants

card_spec.title: Торговый центр
card_spec.rules_text:
Каждое ваше предприятие
с символом «Торговая лавка»
или «Бокал с вилкой»
приносит на 1 монету больше.

generation.prompt: Create a NEW cartoon illustration based on the architecture in the FIRST attached photograph, not a photo edit. The Yaroslavl Kristall mall: modest white two-storey retail building, vivid cobalt-blue narrow rectangular tower projecting above the roof at the front-left corner, two vertically stacked slim white-framed windows in that blue tower. White horizontal siding, long rows of rectangular storefront windows, cobalt-blue horizontal trim around the flat lower roof and along the base, a raised white upper block behind and a small right-side entrance with stairs. Preserve the humble boxy proportions and asymmetry. No text, signs, brand logos or advertisements. Small paving slab, one globe streetlamp, low strip of grass and a tiny cartoon shopper. Exclude the apartment blocks behind it. Style reference is the LAST attached image (yellow building). Match its clean cartoon board-game miniature drawing: bold clean outlines, chunky simplified geometry, broad smooth colors, simple soft cel shading, very sparse surface wear. NO photorealistic rendering, NO fine gritty texture, NO intricate shop interiors. Elevated three-quarter view of a compact isolated building on a small paving slab. Building front and right side visible. All content entirely inside frame with generous transparent margins. Genuine RGBA alpha transparency outside the miniature. No backdrop, sky, halo, vignette or cast shadow outside the base. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, pseudo-writing, billboards or license plate marks anywhere. No card furniture, title, price or rules. Keep a few characteristic Russian everyday details but make them chunky and cartoonish, matching the yellow reference building.
